bukti: we propose a framework for tracking objects of interest over time using a mobile robotic platform equipped with RGB-D camera
we design a multi-object tracking module based on an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) which takes into account the motion of the robot to update the estimate of the localization of the objects
a mobile robot is tasked with tracking table-grape bunches within a vineyard environment
